senses.def: a job or a hotel room that is available
senses.ex: There's a vacancy for a waiter at the new restaurant.
senses.exPt: Tem uma vaga de garçom no restaurante novo.

senses.def: a time when you don't work or study, often spent travelling
senses.ex: We're going to the beach on vacation in July.
senses.exPt: Vamos para a praia nas férias de julho.

senses.def: not clear or not detailed
senses.ex: He gave me a very vague answer.
senses.exPt: Ele me deu uma resposta muito vaga.

senses.def: too proud of your appearance or abilities
senses.ex: He's so vain that he checks his hair in every mirror.
senses.exPt: Ele é tão vaidoso que confere o cabelo em todo espelho.

senses.def: in vain: without success
senses.ex: We tried in vain to find a taxi.
senses.exPt: Tentamos em vão achar um táxi.

senses.def: low land between hills or mountains
senses.ex: The village is in a green valley.
senses.exPt: O vilarejo fica num vale verde.

senses.def: worth a lot of money, or very useful
senses.ex: This old ring is very valuable.
senses.exPt: Este anel antigo é muito valioso.

senses.def: how much money something is worth, or how important it is
senses.ex: The value of our house has gone up a lot.
senses.exPt: O valor da nossa casa subiu muito.

senses.def: a vehicle bigger than a car, used for carrying goods
senses.ex: The delivery van stopped outside our house.
senses.exPt: A van de entregas parou na frente da nossa casa.

senses.def: a number of different kinds of things
senses.ex: The shop sells a wide variety of cheeses.
senses.exPt: A loja vende uma grande variedade de queijos.

senses.def: several different
senses.ex: We talked about various topics during dinner.
senses.exPt: Conversamos sobre vários assuntos durante o jantar.

senses.def: to be different in different situations
senses.ex: Prices vary a lot from shop to shop.
senses.exPt: Os preços variam muito de loja para loja.

senses.def: a container for putting flowers in
senses.ex: Put the flowers in the vase on the table.
senses.exPt: Coloque as flores no vaso em cima da mesa.

senses.def: extremely big
senses.ex: Russia is a vast country with many time zones.
senses.exPt: A Rússia é um país enorme, com muitos fusos horários.

senses.def: a plant or part of a plant that you eat, like a carrot or potato
senses.ex: You should eat more fruit and vegetables.
senses.exPt: Você deveria comer mais frutas e legumes.

senses.def: not eating meat or fish, or containing no meat or fish
senses.ex: Do you have any vegetarian dishes on the menu?
senses.exPt: Vocês têm algum prato vegetariano no cardápio?

senses.def: a machine that carries people or goods, like a car or bus
senses.ex: Please do not leave your vehicle in front of the gate.
senses.exPt: Por favor, não deixe seu veículo em frente ao portão.

senses.def: a tube that carries blood to your heart
senses.ex: The nurse found a vein in my arm.
senses.exPt: A enfermeira achou uma veia no meu braço.

senses.def: a word that shows an action or state, like go or be
senses.ex: Every sentence needs a verb.
senses.exPt: Toda frase precisa de um verbo.

senses.def: used to make an adjective or adverb stronger
senses.ex: It's very hot today.
senses.exPt: Está muito quente hoje.

senses.def: a large boat or ship
senses.ex: The vessel was carrying oil to Europe.
senses.exPt: O navio estava levando petróleo para a Europa.

senses.def: a tube that carries blood through the body
senses.ex: Smoking can damage your blood vessels.
senses.exPt: Fumar pode prejudicar seus vasos sanguíneos.

senses.def: a doctor for animals
senses.ex: We took the dog to the vet yesterday.
senses.exPt: Levamos o cachorro ao veterinário ontem.

senses.def: travelling through a place on the way to another place
senses.ex: We flew to Tokyo via Dubai.
senses.exPt: Voamos para Tóquio passando por Dubai.

senses.def: using a particular person, system or method
senses.ex: I'll send you the documents via email.
senses.exPt: Vou te mandar os documentos por e-mail.

senses.def: next in rank to the leader, and can act for them
senses.ex: She was elected vice president of the club.
senses.exPt: Ela foi eleita vice-presidente do clube.

senses.def: a bad habit, or something bad that someone often does
senses.ex: Chocolate is my only vice.
senses.exPt: Chocolate é o meu único vício.

senses.def: the person with the rank just below a president
senses.ex: She was elected vice president of the company.
senses.exPt: Ela foi eleita vice-presidente da empresa.

senses.def: a person who is hurt or killed by a crime, accident or illness
senses.ex: The victims of the accident were taken to hospital.
senses.exPt: As vítimas do acidente foram levadas ao hospital.

senses.def: the fact of winning a game, competition or war
senses.ex: The team celebrated their victory in the final.
senses.exPt: O time comemorou a vitória na final.

senses.def: a recording of moving pictures that you watch on a screen
senses.ex: He posted a funny video of his cat online.
senses.exPt: Ele postou um vídeo engraçado do gato dele na internet.

senses.def: a short piece of video, often shared online
senses.ex: He posted a funny video clip of his cat online.
senses.exPt: Ele postou um vídeo engraçado do gato dele na internet.

senses.def: a short film made to go with a pop song
senses.ex: The band released a new video clip for their latest song.
senses.exPt: A banda lançou um clipe novo da última música.

senses.def: a game you play on a screen
senses.ex: My brother plays video games every evening.
senses.exPt: Meu irmão joga videogame toda noite.

senses.def: what you can see from a place
senses.ex: Our hotel room has a beautiful view of the sea.
senses.exPt: Nosso quarto de hotel tem uma vista linda para o mar.

senses.def: what you think about something
senses.ex: In my view, the film was too long.
senses.exPt: Na minha opinião, o filme era longo demais.

senses.def: a way of thinking about something
senses.ex: Try to understand the problem from her viewpoint.
senses.exPt: Tente entender o problema do ponto de vista dela.

senses.def: a place from which you can see a beautiful view
senses.ex: We stopped at a viewpoint to take photos of the valley.
senses.exPt: Paramos num mirante para tirar fotos do vale.

senses.def: a very small town in the countryside
senses.ex: My grandparents live in a small village in the mountains.
senses.exPt: Meus avós moram num pequeno vilarejo nas montanhas.

senses.def: behaviour that is meant to hurt or kill people
senses.ex: There is too much violence in films these days.
senses.exPt: Tem violência demais nos filmes hoje em dia.

senses.def: using force to hurt people, or showing this
senses.ex: I don't like violent films.
senses.exPt: Eu não gosto de filmes violentos.

senses.def: in a very strong or violent way
senses.ex: The whole house shook violently during the storm.
senses.exPt: A casa inteira tremeu violentamente durante a tempestade.

senses.def: a musical instrument with four strings that you play with a bow
senses.ex: She has played the violin since she was six.
senses.exPt: Ela toca violino desde os seis anos.

senses.def: made or done using computers or the internet
senses.ex: The museum offers a virtual tour on its website.
senses.exPt: O museu oferece uma visita virtual no seu site.

senses.def: a very small living thing that causes disease
senses.ex: The flu is caused by a virus.
senses.exPt: A gripe é causada por um vírus.

senses.def: an official document that lets you enter a country
senses.ex: You need a visa to visit the United States.
senses.exPt: Você precisa de visto para visitar os Estados Unidos.

senses.def: able to be seen
senses.ex: The mountains are visible from my window.
senses.exPt: As montanhas são visíveis da minha janela.

senses.def: the ability to see, or an idea of the future
senses.ex: She has problems with the vision in her left eye.
senses.exPt: Ela tem problemas de visão no olho esquerdo.

senses.def: to go to see a person or a place
senses.ex: We visited my grandparents last weekend.
senses.exPt: Visitamos meus avós no fim de semana passado.

senses.def: an occasion when you go to see a person or place
senses.ex: Thank you for your visit, come back soon!
senses.exPt: Obrigado pela visita, volte sempre!

senses.def: a person who goes to see a place
senses.ex: The city gets millions of visitors every year.
senses.exPt: A cidade recebe milhões de visitantes todo ano.

senses.def: a person who comes to see you at your home
senses.ex: We're having visitors this weekend.
senses.exPt: Vamos receber visitas neste fim de semana.

senses.def: connected with seeing
senses.ex: The film has amazing visual effects.
senses.exPt: O filme tem efeitos visuais incríveis.

senses.def: in a way that is related to seeing or how something looks
senses.ex: The film is visually beautiful, but the story is boring.
senses.exPt: O filme é visualmente lindo, mas a história é chata.

senses.def: very clear and detailed in your mind
senses.ex: I have vivid memories of my first day at school.
senses.exPt: Tenho lembranças vívidas do meu primeiro dia de aula.

senses.def: of colours: very bright
senses.ex: She always wears clothes in vivid colours.
senses.exPt: Ela sempre usa roupas de cores vivas.

senses.def: in a very clear and detailed way
senses.ex: I vividly remember my first day at school.
senses.exPt: Eu me lembro nitidamente do meu primeiro dia na escola.

senses.def: all the words a person knows or uses
senses.ex: Reading books helps you improve your vocabulary.
senses.exPt: Ler livros ajuda você a melhorar seu vocabulário.

senses.def: the sounds you make when you speak or sing
senses.ex: She has a beautiful voice for singing.
senses.exPt: Ela tem uma voz linda para cantar.

senses.def: a mountain that can send out hot rock, gas and fire
senses.ex: The volcano erupted for the first time in a hundred years.
senses.exPt: O vulcão entrou em erupção pela primeira vez em cem anos.

senses.def: a game where two teams hit a ball over a high net
senses.ex: We play volleyball on the beach every weekend.
senses.exPt: A gente joga vôlei na praia todo fim de semana.

senses.def: how loud a sound is; also one book in a set
senses.ex: Could you turn the volume down a little, please?
senses.exPt: Você pode abaixar um pouco o volume, por favor?

senses.def: the amount of something
senses.ex: The volume of work has doubled this year.
senses.exPt: A quantidade de trabalho dobrou este ano.

senses.def: to work without being paid, usually to help others
senses.ex: She volunteers at an animal shelter on weekends.
senses.exPt: Ela é voluntária num abrigo de animais nos fins de semana.

senses.def: to offer to do something without being asked
senses.ex: He volunteered to wash the dishes after dinner.
senses.exPt: Ele se ofereceu para lavar a louça depois do jantar.

senses.def: to choose someone or something in an election or a group decision
senses.ex: Who did you vote for in the election?
senses.exPt: Em quem você votou na eleição?

senses.def: a choice a person makes in an election
senses.ex: Every vote is important in an election.
senses.exPt: Todo voto é importante numa eleição.

senses.def: a way of deciding something by asking people to choose
senses.ex: Let's have a vote on where to go.
senses.exPt: Vamos fazer uma votação para decidir aonde ir.

senses.def: a speech sound or letter like a, e, i, o or u
senses.ex: In English, the letters A, E, I, O and U are vowels.
senses.exPt: Em inglês, as letras A, E, I, O e U são vogais.

senses.def: a long journey, especially by sea or in space
senses.ex: The voyage across the Atlantic took three weeks.
senses.exPt: A viagem pelo Atlântico levou três semanas.
